notes.subject: plaiim miusik
notes.rationale: זָמַר i tok long 'toktotok long string bilong gita' — 'plaiim miusik' i klostu, tasol piksa bilong string i lus.

notes.subject: toktok long o tingting
notes.rationale: שִׂיחַ i save tok long 'tingting stap long het' o 'toktok aloud' — ol tanima i no gat wanpela mining: KJV 'talk', YLT 'meditate'.

notes.subject: ol man i ritim pes
notes.rationale: Tripela tok bilong tokim man: שירו זמרו שיחו — pes i pulim man long singaut.

translation: Singautim singsing long em, plaiim miusik long em, toktok long olgeta ol samting bilong wonder bilong en.

tokens.gloss: ol samting bilong wonder bilong en
